title: Geometric connectedness is tested on one algebraically closed extension
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $X$ be a scheme over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-over-base], and let $\bar k/k$ be a field extension [def-pc-field-extension] with $\bar k$ algebraically closed [def-weil-algebraic-closure] (every nonconstant polynomial in $\bar k[T]$ has a root in $\bar k$). Then $X$ is geometrically connected over $k$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible] (that is, $X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k'$ [def-pc-base-change] is connected [def-weil-connected-scheme] for every field extension $k'/k$) if and only if the base change $X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}\bar k$ is connected. In particular a geometrically connected scheme over $k$ is nonempty.

source.place: Lemma 33.7.7, tag 0387 (lemma-characterize-geometrically-connected), stated for a separable algebraic closure; the algebraically closed case follows from it and Lemma 33.7.3, tag 054N (lemma-geometrically-connected-check-after-extension)

proof.text: ($\Rightarrow$) If $X$ is geometrically connected over $k$, then by definition $X_{k'}=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k'$ is connected for every field extension $k'/k$; taking $k'=\bar k$ gives that $X_{\bar k}$ is connected.

source.place: Definition 33.7.1 (definition-geometrically-connected), applied to $k'=\overline{k}$; the trivial direction of Lemma 33.7.7, tag 0387

proof.text: ($\Leftarrow$), first: $\bar k$ is separably closed. A nonconstant separable polynomial in $\bar k[T]$ is in particular a nonconstant polynomial, so it has a root in $\bar k$ because $\bar k$ is algebraically closed.

source.place: Lemma 33.7.7, tag 0387: the lemma is stated for a separable algebraic closure; an algebraically closed field is in particular separably algebraically closed, which is all its proof uses of $\overline{k}$

proof.text: ($\Leftarrow$), second: assume $X_{\bar k}$ is connected. Regard $X_{\bar k}$ as a scheme over $\bar k$ through its projection to $\operatorname{Spec}\bar k$. Since $\bar k$ is separably closed (previous step) and $X_{\bar k}$ is connected, [lem-weil-separably-closed-geometrically-connected] applied to the field $\bar k$ and the $\bar k$-scheme $X_{\bar k}$ shows that $X_{\bar k}$ is geometrically connected over $\bar k$, i.e. $(X_{\bar k})_{k''}$ is connected for every field extension $k''/\bar k$.

source.place: proof of Lemma 33.7.7, tag 0387 ('By Lemma [lemma-separably-closed-field-connected-components] we see that $X_{\overline{k}'}$ is connected'), using Lemma 33.7.6, tag 0363

proof.text: ($\Leftarrow$), conclusion: by [lem-weil-geometrically-connected-check-after-extension] applied to the field extension $\bar k/k$, $X$ is geometrically connected over $k$ if and only if $X_{\bar k}$ is geometrically connected over $\bar k$; the latter holds by the previous step, so $X$ is geometrically connected over $k$. (This lemma packages the rest of the proof of tag 0387: for an arbitrary field extension $k'/k$ one takes a common field extension $k'''$ of $k'$ and $\bar k$; then $X_{k'''}=(X_{\bar k})_{k'''}$ is connected and surjects onto $X_{k'}$, so $X_{k'}$ is connected.)

source.place: proof of Lemma 33.7.7, tag 0387, and Lemma 33.7.3, tag 054N (lemma-geometrically-connected-check-after-extension)

proof.text: (Nonemptiness.) If $X$ is geometrically connected over $k$, then taking the trivial extension $k'=k$ the base change $X_k=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k$ is connected; it is isomorphic to $X$ through the first projection (the base change along the identity of $\operatorname{Spec}k$), so $X$ is connected, and a connected space is nonempty by definition. Hence $X\neq\emptyset$.

source.place: remark after Definition 33.7.1 ('By convention a connected topological space is nonempty; hence a fortiori geometrically connected schemes are nonempty')

proof_origin.place: Lemma 33.7.7, tag 0387 (lemma-characterize-geometrically-connected), with its common-extension argument as Lemma 33.7.3, tag 054N, and Lemma 33.7.6, tag 0363; the remark after Definition 33.7.1 for nonemptiness

split_report.summary: Checked the statement against Stacks 0387 (stated there for a separable algebraic closure) and 054N; the statement is correct for any algebraically closed extension and was kept, with the notions it uses (scheme over a base, field extension, algebraically closed) added to stmt_deps and tagged in the text. Wrote the proof in five steps following varieties.tex Section 33.7: the forward direction and nonemptiness are instances of the definition; the converse passes from algebraically closed to separably closed (elementary), then uses tag 0363 (new node lem-weil-separably-closed-geometrically-connected) to get X_kbar geometrically connected over kbar, and tag 054N (new node lem-weil-geometrically-connected-check-after-extension) to descend to k. Mathlib (Geometrically/Connected.lean) has only stability of GeometricallyConnected under base change, i.e. the trivial direction of 054N; neither 0363 nor the converse of 054N nor this lemma is there.
